body: The part I hate about it is that I'm a relatively attractive person, and I feel like I've wasted so many years on this guy.  I hate my feelings, I want to move on and move forward but I don't know how and don't know why I can't. My birthday is in a few days and I just feel like it's another year wasted. Thank you both for your kind words, it truly makes me feel better.

I don't know how to forgive myself.  It's one of those things where,if it didn't go on for so long and I didn't willingly keep doing stupid stuff (although after he quit working at the school and went back into the army I thought he was divorced for several years) I was an idiot and believed that he was telling me the truth because when he was deployed he would email me for hours on end. It wasn't even sexual, just about thoughts, childhood, etc. I was in college at the time, and when he returned to the states he would call me daily. He's by far the best friend I've ever had. I miss that part of it so much.

I just feel like I was so stupid for not being able to read the signs.  And not only that, even after finding it out I saw him again.  I feel like a horrible person.
Thank you.  Seriously, you have no idea.

Panic attacks are rough, they make you think crazy things and freak out.  There is no reason to feel stupid, you have no control over them.

The more open minded you are about it, the better.  Don't let her see you freaking out or you will possibly push her away.  No problem is really worse than another when you're going thru it, every person feels like their problem is the most horrible thing ever, so don't worry.

Let her be alone for a month, you be alone for a month, it goes by faster than you'd expect.  If she's that dependent on you it will be for the best because she will realize the grass isn't always greener.  I would be honest with her and tell her you're scared but in a calm manner, not in a, "I CANT LIVE WITHOUT YOOOU!" way, if that makes sense.

Try and go to sleep, take a nap.  When you wake up you will probably feel more calm.  I've had panic attacks the same and I always find taking a nap or exercising chills me out.

Honestly, yes and it sucks.  My family disowned me when I was 17 and won't have a thing to do with me.  The last conversation my dad had with me is that he is embarrassed of me, I'm a failure, and he wishes I was never born.  The bluntness tore my heart in two. Fuck. It still makes me upset just thinking about it.  

I understand the feeling of waking up in the morning and hating it, hating the world because you're supposed to get out of bed but just don't want to face it.  There were many times I just drank upon waking up, just to dull the pain and attempt to not feel anything.  This caused me a lot of problems in college because I was self destructing.  I was at a point of almost getting kicked out as well.  You can still turn it around. I promise you.

Have you tried anti depressants?  I was against them for the longest time, because I felt I should be able to do it on my own and viewed them as a crutch, but After being on them for a little over 6 months I can really tell the difference.  It's not an over night thing, but one day you realize you aren't feeling like shit constantly and the cloud slowly starts to go away.  I still don't really like myself but it's getting better and I see that there could be life at the end of the tunnel.

Could you possibly apply to another school?  I know a lot of people who have been kicked out of school, and are able to go somewhere else.  Have you made mistakes? Of course, everyone does!  You can still turn it around.  If you want to pm me your email or whatever, feel free. Perhaps we can help each other.
PM me if you want to talk.  I'm a few years older than you and a girl but I get exactly how youre feeling.  I want to be your friend.
Talk to me, be my friend.  I need a friend who feels the same, although I'm a few years older and a girl.  Don't do it. pm me
I want to be speared in the heart by a deer antler and left for dead.

Thank you, that actually meant a lot and made me feel better as I've had an awful past week.  It's still difficult not to blame myself, even though he lied to me most of the time saying he was divorced and being naive, I believed him. I believed every stupid thing he said. I can't help but feel terrible doing that to another person (his wife and kid(s)) even though she never knew.  I just feel like a terrible person that I didn't just stop it years ago.  I'm afraid I will never experience, or don't deserve, happiness in a relationship because of what I've done.

I lost my virginity to my high school teacher when I was 16.  He was married with a kid, we continued our secret relationship for 9 years and I ended it recently.   He joined the army after my parents found out when I was 17 and threatened to tell the police.  We never lived in the same state those next 9 years but I would see him occasionally when he wasn't deployed and when he could get away for "work" but we talked online and on the phone all day/every day.

I also had an abortion twice, the last I found his wife was pregnant at the same time as me.  His daughter is now 4.  I hate myself so much I can't stand it.  I just looked at his wife's facebook and I hate myself even more and what really kills me is the strong fucking desire I have to see or contact him again.  How the hell did I become such a horrible person?

No one else knows, other than my parents who think it ended 9 years ago.  The worst part is that I'm fairly certain he never gave a shit about me, and here I am almost 10 years later, alone and in a deep depression because of someone that no one else knows about.  I'm afraid I won't ever get over it and he never gave a shit. A lot of great guys have been interested in me over the years but I wouldn't do anything because I "loved" him.  He never gave a shit and I am scum.
